task: Add an observational REV acceptance check to SDK pull requests, with commit-bound evidence collection.

criteria.description: The collector includes the exact checked-out PR head SHA, base revision, implementation diff and supplied behavioral observations; it rejects a mismatched head SHA and reuse of an unchanged task from the base revision.
The collector fails for missing behavioral evidence, duplicate source IDs, source files outside the repository, and evidence exceeding the 1 MiB corpus limit, without silently truncating evidence.
